title: Lazy Cat Runner
description: Guide a chubby orange tabby sprinting across sunny rooftops and city lanes—leap over hurdles, snack on fish treats, and chase nonstop high scores.
controls: Swipe left, right, up, or down to switch lanes, jump over barriers, and slide under obstacles.

zh-CN.title: 懒猫跑酷
zh-CN.description: 萌系 3D 治愈系懒猫跑酷：操控胖橘猫在阳光街区和屋顶飞奔跳跃、一路狂吃小鱼干躲避障碍刷新最高分！
zh-CN.controls: 左右滑动切换跑道，上下滑动跳跃翻滚躲避障碍，收集沿途小鱼干与金币。
